protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: unauthenticated _proxurl input is decoded into $_url, parsed into $_url_parts, checked only by preg_match of a literal-host regex, then passed by hostname to stream_socket_client. A nonmatching attacker-controlled hostname can therefore resolve to loopback or private space after the check; the advisory PoC documents this DNS-to-127.0.0.1 bypass.

findings: CVE-2025-52362 is currently PUBLISHED at CVE.org; GHSA-37c4-9pw5-3r33 has withdrawn_at=null. The advisory and referenced disclosure describe PHProxy <=1.1.1 and the _proxurl DNS-to-private-address SSRF bypass.
The mechanism, atomic BIC, parent boundary, affected-tag ancestry, unpatched HEAD, and BIC-only human attribution independently reproduce the primary NOT_AI judgment.
The primary record's introducer_parent_absent=false contradicts its own evidence and the verified parent tree; this structural field requires correction to true.
remaining_gap: No remaining causal-attribution gap. The repository remains unpatched for the disclosed DNS-resolution bypass, so no direct fix SHA or fixed release can be recorded.
